recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current core source satisfies the published Jira decision and later related decisions reinforce the same behavior; no follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-22103.
issue_request: FHIR-22103 was a Published FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking for clarity when Provenance.target holds version-specific references but clients need to find Provenance records for a non-version-specific target resource. The approved resolution was to update search.html#versions so a Reference search value without /_history/[version] matches the specified URL independent of version, and to make the _include documentation also refer to _revinclude.
initial_application: Commit 723edd92686c3667d435b854fefabb1618dc20d6 applied FHIR-22103 directly to source/search.html by adding the References and Versions rule that a reference-type search parameter without a version matches resources containing both versioned and un-versioned references, and by changing the versioned include guidance to name both _include and _revinclude. The current source retains those changes.
additional_context: Provenance remains an active core resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml still describes Provenance.target as usually version specific, which is the scenario the issue was meant to support. Later Published issues FHIR-36715 and FHIR-36716 refined the adjacent reference-search syntax and explicitly confirmed that an unversioned reference search such as Provenance?target=Patient/example should match versioned target references. Later FHIR-45428 was resolved No Change and said that clients wanting all Provenances for a resource irrespective of target version should use a separate non-versioned search against Provenance.target, which aligns with the FHIR-22103 rule rather than replacing it.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Search page already states in source/search.html#versions that an unversioned reference-type search parameter matches versioned and un-versioned references, and the same section's include guidance already names both _include and _revinclude. The current reference search section also has examples showing a non-versioned search value matching a versioned reference to the same target resource.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue clarified version-specific relative Reference search parameter syntax used by the same Search page section. It already has a combined-branch reconcile audit and was not re-decided here.

Later Published issue clarified that non-versioned relative reference searches should match instances containing versioned references to the same target resource. It already has a combined-branch reconcile fix and was used as supporting context.

Later Resolved - No Change issue rejected a new version-independent _revinclude mechanism and directed clients to a separate non-versioned Provenance.target search, supporting this no-change decision.
Earlier Security issue about returning Provenance via _revinclude was already audited separately and is supported by, but does not decide, this version-matching rule.
